profile.heroTitle: Engineering Quality for a Better Tomorrow
profile.heroDescription: Software Quality Assurance leader with 20+ years of experience across QA leadership, enterprise systems, test automation, API validation and performance engineering.
profile.summary: I help teams build reliable software through practical QA strategy, strong collaboration, thoughtful automation and continuous quality improvement.

experience.summary: Leads QA planning, strategy, execution, team coordination and process improvement across enterprise applications.
Led testing and QA documentation across multiple projects in Agile/Scrum environments.
Managed QA planning, resources, testing, defect management and mentoring for enterprise products.
Led QA scope, plans, resource estimates, testing and team communication.
Performed functional, integration, regression, security and usability testing.
Performed requirements analysis, software testing, implementation and user training.
Worked on requirements analysis, software development, testing, implementation and training.

projects.title: 20-20 Commercial Software
projects.description:
A commercial software - 2D/3D CAD, Space Planning & Visualization suite included:

▶️ 20-20 Worksheet – product/order and specification workflow.
▶️ 20-20 Giza Designer – space planning and design.
▶️ 20-20 CAP Designer – cabinet design and manufacturing-related design.
▶️ 20-20 Visual Impression – 3D visualization and presentation.

I was responsible for overall product quality assurance and QA leadership across the project lifecycle. I defined QA scope, objectives, test strategy, resource requirements, and quality deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders. I led functional, integration, regression, security, usability, compatibility, ad-hoc, automation, and performance testing activities.

leadership.title: Building Quality Teams for a Better Tomorrow
leadership.subtitle: Quality leadership is about creating confidence, capability and ownership across the team.

philosophy.title: Quality Ownership
philosophy.text: Quality is shared ownership across the delivery team, not only the QA function.

philosophy.title: Risk-Based Thinking
philosophy.text: Focus testing effort where failure would create the greatest business and user risk.

philosophy.title: Shift-Left Quality
philosophy.text: Improve quality early through requirements review, collaboration and early validation.

philosophy.title: Continuous Improvement
philosophy.text: Improve processes, tools, automation and team capability continuously.

principles: Testing starts from requirements, not from code.
Automation should reduce risk, not just execution time.
People grow when they are trusted and given responsibility.
